User Story: As a learner, I want to browse available courses so that I can find a course to study.
As a learner, I want to search courses by keyword so that I can find relevant content quickly.
As a learner, I want to view course details so that I can decide whether to enrol.
As a learner, I want to enrol in an available course so that I can begin learning.
As a learner, I want to resume from my last completed lesson so that I can continue learning.
As a learner, I want to mark a lesson complete so that my progress is recorded.
As a learner, I want to take an assessment so that I can demonstrate what I learned.
As a learner, I want to view my assessment result so that I understand my performance.
As an eligible learner, I want to download my course certificate so that I can share proof of completion.
As a learner, I want to receive a course completion notification so that I know when I finish a course.
As a learner, I want to view my completed courses so that I can track my learning journey.
As a learner, I want to retry an assessment when permitted so that I can improve my result.
